facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary and secondary endpoints, oral insulin T2D activities to stop · Phase 3 · ORMD-0801 in type 2 diabetes · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The trial did not meet its primary endpoint, which compared the efficacy of ORMD-0801 to placebo in improving glycemic control as assessed by the mean change from baseline in A1C at 26 weeks.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The trial did not meet its primary endpoint, which compared the efficacy of ORMD-0801 to placebo in improving glycemic control as assessed by the mean change from baseline in A1C at 26 weeks.
evidence.safety: There were no serious drug-related adverse events.
evidence.program_discontinued: As a result, the Company expects to discontinue its oral insulin clinical activities for T2D.
